name: The Affray
summary: On Fray Island, warriors face challengers before Klannoc Macleod will train them. The Affray tests their strength against the island’s fighters and its champion.

sections.title: A Proving Ground in the Great Sea
sections.body: Fray Island lies apart from the mainland and draws brawlers, outcasts, and combat instructors. Klannoc Macleod does not train every wanderer who arrives by boat. Warriors seeking his lessons must enter the Affray first. There, their stamina and awareness in battle show whether they can fight beyond mere boasting.

sections.title: The Circle of Iron and Blood
sections.body: A warrior begins the Affray by stepping onto the central iron grate among the spectators. Then Ringmaster Twiggy Flathead sends challengers into the ring one after another. Those who survive face the island’s heavyweight champion, Big Will. Only by defeating him can a warrior earn Klannoc’s respect.

faq.answer: The Affray tests aspiring warriors in a series of arena fights on Fray Island. Klannoc Macleod judges whether they are ready for advanced combat training.

faq.q: Where does the Affray take place?
faq.answer: The Affray takes place on Fray Island, off the Barrens’ eastern coast in the Great Sea.
Warrior trainer Klannoc Macleod oversees the island’s fighters and sets the trial. Twiggy Flathead directs the bouts from the edge of the pit.

faq.q: How does the combat in the ring work?
faq.answer: A warrior steps onto the central iron grate to signal readiness. Twiggy Flathead sends Affray Challengers into the pit in waves, then releases the island champion, Big Will.
Big Will is the reigning champion of Fray Island’s brawlers. Defeating him is the final requirement to pass the Affray.

faq.q: Why must warriors complete this trial?
faq.answer: Klannoc Macleod will not teach his martial techniques until a warrior proves their toughness against multiple opponents.

angles.text: As a warrior, you face the Affray to prove your battle stances and endurance. Show your worth there, and Klannoc Macleod will consider you for deeper mastery of your craft.
